test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The woman exclaimed that the kids were making too much noise.

options.text: The woman said, “How much noise are the kids making!”
The woman said, “The kids were making too much noise.”
The woman said, “What noise are the kids making?"
The woman said, “How the kids are making too much noise!”

solution:
The correct answer is: **The woman said, “How much noise are the kids making!”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• An **exclamatory sentence** has a sign of exclamation after it which changes into a full stop in the indirect speech.
 
• The **"full stop"** in the indirect speech changes to **Exclamation Point ( ! )** in the direct speech.
 
• The reported verb 'exclaimed' changes to 'said' in the reporting speech part.
 
• To express the exclamatory phrase, **"What! Oh! How!"** are used. (Express surprise)
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The helping verb 'were' in the indirect part changes to 'are' in the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *The woman said, “How much noise are the kids making!”*
